tools.name: company_group
tools.description: The corporate group a company belongs to, from the relationship records companies report to GLEIF (Level 2, CC0): the group head (the ultimate parent), every country the group reaches with its number of companies and the company that leads it (its country head, the top group company there; in the country of the group head the lead is the group head itself, role group_head, not a second country head), and a page of the group companies sorted by country, then depth below the head, then name. role says where the company stands: group_head, country_head or member. Costs 2 credits; an answer with no group, or a page with no company, costs nothing. Scope limits: only companies with an LEI that report their parent, and the parents they name, appear, so most companies have no group (data.group is null with a notice: null means GLEIF holds none, not that none exists); the relationships are accounting consolidation as GLEIF holds them, not an ownership register; a company that reports no direct parent inside the group hangs under the group head (parent_in_group false); funds, branches and inactive entities are included as reported; company_id and company_country link a group company to a Prometiam record only where we serve its LEI and the key may open that country, else null. Source: GLEIF Level 2 relationship records (CC0); meta.data_as_of is the date of the golden copy, refreshed daily.

country.description: Country code: ES (Spain, BORME), FR (France, BODACC), GB (UK, Companies House), IE (Ireland, CRO), PL (Poland, KRS), NO (Norway, Brønnøysundregistrene / Enhetsregisteret), FI (Finland, Kaupparekisteri, the Finnish Trade Register), SE (Sweden, Bolagsverket, the Swedish Companies Registration Office), HR (Croatia, Sudski registar, the Croatian court register), BE (Belgium, KBO/BCE, the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises), DK (Denmark, CVR, the Danish Central Business Register), EE (Estonia, the e-Business Register, RIK), SK (Slovakia, RPO, the Register of Legal Entities), CH (Switzerland, Zefix, the Swiss central business name index), LV (Latvia, the Register of Enterprises, Uzņēmumu reģistrs), CY (Cyprus, DRCOR, the Department of the Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property), RO (Romania, ONRC, the National Trade Register Office), LT (Lithuania, JAR, the Register of Legal Entities), CA (Canada, Corporations Canada, federal corporations only), AU (Australia, ASIC and the Australian Business Register), JP (Japan, the National Tax Agency corporate number publication site), IL (Israel, the Corporations Authority), BR (Brazil, CNPJ, Receita Federal), AR (Argentina, the Registro Nacional de Sociedades of the Ministry of Justice, built from the register of legal persons of ARCA, the tax authority; commercial companies only, register-change events and monitoring since 28 Oct 2026, read monthly, none before that date, and no dissolution alert), UA (Ukraine, the Unified State Register of Legal Entities, Individual Entrepreneurs and Public Organisations, EDR, of the Ministry of Justice of Ukraine; commercial legal persons only), RS (Serbia, the Register of Business Entities of the Business Registers Agency, APR; companies only: d.o.o., a.d., o.d. and k.d.; the matični broj is the company number; register-change events and monitoring since the October 2026 launch, read monthly), KR (South Korea, the OpenDART electronic disclosure system of the Financial Supervisory Service; only filers with a commercial company form (주식회사, 유한회사, 유한책임회사, 합자회사, 합명회사), not every Korean company; the OpenDART corporation code, 8 digits, is the company number and business_number= finds a company by its business registration number; the status is always unknown and there is no dissolution date; no officers, no shareholders, no share capital, no VAT number, no financial statements and no insolvency notices; register-change events (name, legal form, address) none before the first South Korean load, no monitoring; updated every business day. Contains data from the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) of the Republic of Korea, OpenDART electronic disclosure system (https://opendart.fss.or.kr), public data under the Act on Promotion of the Provision and Use of Public Data. Adapted by Prometiam; not an official FSS extract.), SI (Slovenia, the Business Register of Slovenia, PRS, of AJPES, from its open list; companies only: d.o.o., d.d., d.n.o., k.d. and SE; the matična številka is the company number; the status is read only from the bankruptcy or liquidation marker in the name; no dates, activity code, share capital, VAT number, officers or insolvency notices; financial statements (company_financials) only for listed companies (ESEF reports) and the banks of the EBA Transparency Exercise 2025; register-change events and monitoring, none before the first load in November 2026, read about every two weeks), MT (Malta, company records from the open data of the Malta Business Registry (MBR): the register number with its prefix (for example C 51037) is the company number and the LEI a second identifier; private and public limited companies, Societas Europea and partnerships only, so funds (SICAVs), overseas companies and European Economic Interest Groupings are never served; status active, in_dissolution, deregistered or merged; the NACE class only where the register states an activity; no officers, no share capital, no VAT number (a vat search is refused) and no insolvency notices; financial statements (company_financials) only for listed companies (ESEF reports) and the banks of the EBA Transparency Exercise 2025; register-change events and monitoring, none before the Malta launch; updated daily. Credit: Contains data from the Malta Business Registry (MBR), "Basic Company Information" open data, published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (CC BY 4.0). Adapted by Prometiam (one record per company; names, addresses, dates and statuses normalised); not an official register extract. Contains LEI data from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), available under CC0 1.0.), GR (Greece, company records from the General Commercial Registry (G.E.MI.): the 12-digit GEMI number (a head office ends in 000) is the company number, the AFM is identifiers.afm and the LEI a further identifier; the VAT number is EL plus the AFM, built by rule and not confirmed; companies and cooperatives in every status only, never branches, sole proprietorships, civil companies, joint ventures, European Economic Interest Groupings, energy communities or co-ownerships; the NACE class read off the activity code; no registration date, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no shareholders, no filings and no insolvency notices; financial statements (company_financials) from the balance-sheet announcements GEMI publishes, for AE, IKE and EPE companies, read gradually, largest companies first, so most have none yet; register-change events (none before 24 Oct 2026) and monitoring; new registrations read every day and the whole register every seven days. Credit: Contains data from the General Commercial Registry (Γ.Ε.ΜΗ.), Central GEMI Service, Hellenic Federation of Chambers of Commerce (KEEE), available under the ODC-BY 1.0 licence (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/odc-by). Adapted by Prometiam. Contains LEI data from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), available under CC0 1.0.), NC (New Caledonia, the list of active enterprises of the Ridet, published every quarter by the ISEE, the statistics office: a statistical directory, not a commercial register, and not the whole population of legal units; companies only (SARL, EURL, SELARL, SAS, SA, SNC, civil companies, GIE, cooperatives), never associations, sole traders, public bodies or foreign legal persons; the RID7, seven digits with their leading zeros, is the company number and an establishment’s ten-digit Ridet number is reduced to it; status active, or deregistered with no date; commune and province only; the NAF rev. 2 activity code; no street address, no founding or registration date, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no VAT number (a vat search is refused), no financial statements and no insolvency notices; no register-change events and no monitoring; updated every quarter. Credit: Contains data from the Institut de la statistique et des études économiques de Nouvelle-Calédonie (ISEE), Ridet, liste des entreprises actives, original data downloaded from www.isee.nc, updated 21 October 2026, under the Licence Ouverte. Adapted by Prometiam (companies only, activity code and legal form normalised); not the whole population of legal units of New Caledonia and not an official register extract.), PE (Peru, a partial list of the legal entities that sold to the Peruvian state since 2003, from the open contracting data of the OECE, not Peru's company register; a company that never sold to the state is absent, and sole traders (RUC 10, 15 and 17) and natural persons are never served; the RUC is the company number, 11 digits starting 20 with SUNAT's modulo 11 check digit enforced; served: name, RUC and the street where the data gives one (few do; city, region and postal code never); no status (null), no founding or registration date, no legal form code, no activity code, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no contacts, no VAT number (a vat search is refused), no financial statements and no insolvency notices; no register-change events and no monitoring; updated monthly, with a lag (the newest awards are not in yet), and the name and address are those of the newest award. Credit: Contains data from the Organismo Especializado para las Contrataciones Públicas Eficientes (OECE) of Peru, the legal entities that sold to the Peruvian state since 2003, published through the Open Contracting Data Registry (https://data.open-contracting.org/en/publication/135) under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) licence. Adapted by Prometiam (legal entities only, one record per company); not Peru's company register and not an official extract.), HN (Honduras, a partial list of the legal entities that sold to the Honduran state since 2005, from the open contracting data of the ONCAE, not Honduras's company register; a company that never sold to the state is absent, and national identity numbers (people) and the ONCAE's internal codes are never served; the RTN is the company number, 14 digits with a 9 in the fifth place and no check digit; served: name, RTN and the street line as filed (no city or region); no status (null), no founding or registration date, no legal form code, no activity code, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no contacts, no VAT number (a vat search is refused), no financial statements and no insolvency notices; no register-change events and no monitoring; updated monthly, with a lag (the newest awards are not in yet), and the name and address are those of the newest award. Credit: Contains data from the Oficina Normativa de Contratación y Adquisiciones del Estado (ONCAE) of Honduras, the legal entities that sold to the Honduran state since 2005, published through the Open Contracting Data Registry (https://data.open-contracting.org/en/publication/122) under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) licence. Adapted by Prometiam (legal entities only, one record per company); not Honduras's company register and not an official extract.), GT (Guatemala, a partial list of the legal entities that bid to or sold to the Guatemalan state, from the Guatecompras open data, not Guatemala's company register; a company that only bid is served too, one that never bid is absent, and natural persons and co-ownerships of persons are never served; the NIT is the company number, written NNNNNNN-D with a modulo 11 check digit (K allowed) enforced; served: name, NIT, street, locality (city), department (region) and the legal-entity type as text (legal_form_full); no status (null), no founding or registration date, no legal form code, no activity code, no share capital, no head count, no officers, no contacts, no VAT number (a vat search is refused), no financial statements and no insolvency notices; no register-change events and no monitoring; updated monthly, with a lag (the newest awards are not in yet), and the name and address are those of the newest award. Credit: Contains data from Guatecompras, Ministerio de Finanzas Públicas of Guatemala, the legal entities that bid to or sold to the Guatemalan state, published as open contracting data (https://ocds.guatecompras.gt/descarga-datos) under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) licence. Adapted by Prometiam (legal entities only, one record per company); not Guatemala's company register and not an official extract.), MD (Moldova, State Register of legal units, kept by the Public Services Agency (ASP) and published as open data: companies only (SRL, SA, SNC, SC), the 13-digit IDNO is the company number; no officers, share capital, VAT number, activity code or financials; register-change events and monitoring; updated weekly), UY (Uruguay, RUPE, the register of state suppliers of ARCE: a partial list, not the company register; the 12-digit RUT is the company number; legal entities registered as state suppliers only; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials; updated monthly), DO (Dominican Republic, MICM open data on certified MIPYMES: a partial list, not the company register; the 9-digit RNC is the company number; name only, no address; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials; the served list is shared under the ODbL licence, share-alike; updated monthly), NZ (New Zealand, the Charities Register of Charities Services: registered and deregistered charities that are legal entities, not companies and not the company register; the NZBN or the CC charity number is the company number; no events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials; updated weekly), BG (Bulgaria, the open contracting data of the Public Procurement Agency: companies that sold to the state in 2026 only, a partial list, not the commercial register; the 9-digit EIK is the company number; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials), GE (Georgia, the open contracting data of the State Procurement Agency: a frozen history of state suppliers to June 2019, never updated again, not the company register; the 9-digit identification code is the company number; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials), TZ (Tanzania, the open contracting data of the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority: a partial list of state suppliers as at February 2026, nothing added since, not the company register; the BRELA number is the company number; shared under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence, share-alike; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials), ZM (Zambia, the open contracting data of the Zambia Public Procurement Authority: a partial list of state suppliers, not the company register; the 12-digit PACRA number is the company number; no status, events, monitoring, officers, VAT number, activity code or financials; updated monthly), EC (Ecuador, the company directory of the Superintendencia de Companias, Valores y Seguros joined on the RUC with the Catastro RUC of the Servicio de Rentas Internas; limited companies of the SCVS list only; the RUC is the company number; register-change events and monitoring none before the Ecuador launch, read monthly), CL (Chile, the Registro de Empresas y Sociedades (RES), Ministerio de Economía, Fomento y Turismo; only the companies registered under the simplified regime of Ley 20.659 since 2013, not the whole Chilean register; the RUT is the company number; no register-change events and no monitoring), CO (Colombia, RUES, Confecámaras), SG (Singapore, ACRA), TW (Taiwan, GCIS and the Ministry of Finance), CZ (Czech Republic, the public register of the Ministry of Justice and the Czech Statistical Office RES), DE (Germany, LEI-registered entities and energy-market register companies, not the commercial register), NL (Netherlands, LEI-registered entities with a KVK number, not the Dutch commercial register), MX (Mexico, LEI-registered entities and the companies of INEGI's DENUE directory of economic units, not the Mexican company register), or US (United States: state business registers, SEC EDGAR and GLEIF). Ireland, Finland, Sweden, Croatia, Belgium, Denmark, Estonia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Latvia, Cyprus, Romania, Lithuania, Canada, Australia, Japan, Israel, Singapore, Colombia, Taiwan, Germany, the Netherlands, Ukraine, Serbia, Slovenia, Malta, South Korea, Greece, New Caledonia, Peru, Honduras, Guatemala, Moldova, Uruguay, the Dominican Republic, New Zealand, Bulgaria, Georgia, Tanzania, Zambia, Ecuador, Chile, Mexico, Argentina, Brazil and the United States are company-level (companies only). Norway has companies and officers; the Czech Republic has companies and, as appointments on the company record (no extra credit), its officers and partners: the statutory body, administrative and supervisory boards, control commission, partners (with the deposit and share where the register gives one amount and a percentage or fraction), the sole shareholder of a joint-stock company, procurators and liquidators the register lists today, with the function in Czech; a natural person is the name as published and the month and year of birth only (no day, birth number, address or nationality); a company member carries its name, IČO and foreign register number; no officer history (a member who leaves drops out at the next read); no person records, no search by officer name and no director network; representatives of company members, the way of acting, pledges and insolvency administrators are not served; officer changes are not register-change events; companies deleted before 2026 have no officers; an empty list means the register lists no such member; updated daily; Poland has companies and officers on the company record (management board, supervisory board, proxies and the representation rule from the KRS full extract; natural persons are masked by the register itself, so no person records, and the list is filled progressively); Ireland, Poland and Norway have register-change events only, from 14 Oct 2026 (no gazette). Finland, Sweden, Belgium, Croatia, Denmark, Estonia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Latvia, Cyprus, Romania, Lithuania, Canada, Australia, Japan, Israel, Singapore, Colombia, Taiwan, Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, Ukraine, Serbia, Slovenia, South Korea, Malta, Ecuador, Argentina, Greece, Moldova, Brazil, the United States and every LEI layer have register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address; share capital for HR, EE, SK, CH, LV, LT, TW, BR and CZ; for Ukraine name, status, legal form and share capital, no registered address; for Serbia the address is the municipality), dated when the change first appears in the register data (for the United States, the weekly read of the registers that first sees it) and none before 2026-09-30 (for a country or LEI layer added later, none before its first load), and monitoring (not South Korea). Company records from the Finnish Trade Register: legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal. Corporate insolvency notices are linked by business ID. Sweden: Company records from the Swedish Companies Registration Office (Bolagsverket): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal, and sole traders (enskild näringsverksamhet) are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (konkurs, företagsrekonstruktion, ackordsförhandling; weekly, no court or case number) are linked by organisationsnummer. Croatia: Company records from the Croatian court register (Sudski registar): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal, and sole traders (trgovac pojedinac) are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (court decisions, with court and case number where the register states them) are linked by MBS. Belgium: Company records from the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no insolvency notices (Belgium is not an insolvency market: a bankruptcy shows in the company status and in its register-change events), and enterprises of natural persons (eenmanszaak / entreprise individuelle) are never served. Denmark: Company records from the Danish Central Business Register (CVR): legal name, legal form, status (including the register's bankruptcy state), registered address, activity code and dates; no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no share capital, and sole proprietorships (enkeltmandsvirksomhed) and estates are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (konkurs and tvangsakkord from CVR credit information: one notice per proceeding, dated by the decision that opened it, with the latest stage of the proceeding; no court or case number) are linked by CVR number. Estonia: Company records from the Estonian e-Business Register (RIK): legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation and bankruptcy), registered address, activity code (EMTAK 2008 or 2025, per company) and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers and no registry-compliance signal. Its bankruptcy declarations are served as insolvency notices. Sole traders (FIE) are never served, and the VAT number (KMKR) is searchable with `vat=`. Slovakia: Company records from the Slovak Register of Legal Entities (RPO): legal name, legal form, status (including bankruptcy (konkurz) and restructuring), registered address, activity code (SK NACE Rev. 2.1) and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no insolvency notices. Commercial legal persons only (no associations, foundations or other non-commercial entities); VAT number from the Slovak Financial Administration list of VAT payers (null for a company not on the list; a `vat` search by IČ DPH finds it); sole traders and other natural persons are never served. Romania: Company records from the National Trade Register Office (ONRC): legal name, legal form, status (including dissolution, liquidation, insolvency, reorganisation, bankruptcy and deregistration), registered address with the county, CAEN activity codes, the J registration number and EUID, and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no share capital and no insolvency notices. Natural persons and sole traders are never served. The CUI (2 to 10 digits, check digit advisory) is the company_number; the Romanian VAT number (RO plus the CUI, built by rule) is searchable with `vat=`. Cyprus: Company records from the Department of the Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property (DRCOR): legal name, legal form, status (including strike-off pending, voluntary and compulsory liquidation and administration), registered address with the district and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no activity code, no share capital, no VAT number (a vat search is refused) and no insolvency notices. Companies and overseas companies only; trade names and partnerships are never served. Latvia: Company records from the Register of Enterprises of the Republic of Latvia (Uzņēmumu reģistrs): legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation, insolvency and legal protection proceedings), registered address with the region, share capital, previous names and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no activity code. Its Insolvency Register proceedings are served as insolvency notices. Individual merchants and other natural persons are never served. The registration number (11 digits, an LV prefix optional, with a mod-11 check that is enforced) is the company_number, and the Latvian VAT number (LV plus the registration number) is searchable with `vat=`. Switzerland: Company records from Zefix, the Swiss central business name index: legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation), registered address with the canton and business purpose; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no activity code (the register publishes no NOGA code). Legal entities and branches only; sole proprietorships (Einzelunternehmen) and other natural persons are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (SHAB) are linked by UID where the notice names the debtor's UID. Commercial-register publications of the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce (SHAB) are served as gazette events for Swiss legal entities and branches, from publications of 1 January 2024 (new entry, change of name, seat, address, purpose, capital, legal form, auditor, board or signatories, merger, liquidation, bankruptcy, deletion), dated by the publication date, linked by UID, with the SHAB publication as notice_url; the notice text and the names of board members and signatories are never served (a board or signatory change says only that persons changed). The gazette events are a summary derived from the SOGC publications; the publication linked as notice_url is the authoritative text. The UID with its MWST, TVA or IVA suffix is searchable with `vat=`. United States: there is no national register, so the API serves company records from the business registers of New York, Colorado, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, Florida, Iowa, the District of Columbia, Texas, Oregon and Massachusetts (state open data and public records) plus SEC filers (EDGAR) and LEI holders (GLEIF) from every state, Delaware included, as one record per state registration (domestic or foreign); numbers look like NY-4424185, CO-20091096973, DE-10684990, CIK-0000320193 or LEI-… and identifiers also carry the SEC CIK, the EIN of SEC filers and the LEI; New York, Pennsylvania, Iowa and Oregon publish active entities only (Florida serves active and inactive entities: profit corporations, limited liability companies, limited partnerships and non-profit corporations, domestic and foreign; the District of Columbia serves every status, a closed one with its reason, and Iowa the home-office address, neither with registered agents or beneficial owners; Texas serves franchise tax taxpayers that hold a Secretary of State file number, from the file of the Comptroller of Public Accounts and not the Secretary of State register, forfeited and closed ones with their status; Oregon serves limited liability companies, business, professional and non-profit corporations, limited partnerships, limited liability partnerships and cooperatives with the principal place of business as address (the mailing address for limited partnerships, which have none), never assumed business names (trade names), business trusts, reserved names or acts of government, and has no registered agents or authorized representatives; Massachusetts serves every status (active, dissolved, revoked, withdrawn, and inactive where no reason is given), domestic and foreign business, professional, benefit and non-profit corporations, limited liability companies, limited partnerships, registered limited liability partnerships, co-operatives and the Chapter 180 and special-statute corporations, from the public-record extract of the Corporations Division (19 Oct 2026; refreshed, with its change events, only when the Division supplies a newer extract), not an official register extract, never trade names (foreign DBAs), voluntary associations, trusts or corporations sole, and has no officers or resident agents) and the SEC gives no legal status; updated weekly; company-level (no officers and no registry-compliance signal, with register-change events (dated by the weekly read) and monitoring), no VAT number (a `vat` search is refused), sole proprietorships never served, and not every US company. US insolvency notices are on insolvency_search and are not linked to the company records. US sources: New York Department of State, Colorado Secretary of State, Connecticut Secretary of the State, Pennsylvania Department of State (open data), Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations (public records), Iowa Secretary of State (CC BY 4.0), District of Columbia Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (CC BY 4.0), Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts (franchise tax data), Oregon Secretary of State, Corporation Division (open data), Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, Corporations Division (public-record extract of 19 Oct 2026; not an official register extract and not endorsed by the Secretary), SEC EDGAR, GLEIF (CC0). Lithuania: Company records from the Register of Legal Entities (JAR): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Company status includes liquidation, bankruptcy and restructuring; there are no insolvency notices. Activity codes follow NACE Rev. 2.1 (EVRK 2.1, class level; the 6-digit code is in registry_details). Share capital is held for UAB and AB only. VAT numbers come from the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI) list. Sole proprietorships, partnerships (KUB, TUB), branches, state enterprises and non-commercial bodies are never served. Credit: Contains data from the Register of Legal Entities (JAR), Registrų centras, the State Data Agency (Statistics Lithuania) and the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI), CC BY 4.0. Adapted by Prometiam. Canada: Company records from Corporations Canada (Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Federal corporations only (Canada Business Corporations Act, Canada Cooperatives Act and the repealed Canada Corporations Act Part I and Cooperative Associations Act); provincial and territorial corporations, not-for-profit corporations and boards of trade are not in the register. There is no insolvency, liquidation or bankruptcy status (that is the Office of the Superintendent of Bankruptcy and the courts), no activity code, share capital or VAT number. The Business Number is searchable with business_number=, and a corporation's other names are in registry_details. Credit: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Corporations Canada, Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada). Adapted by Prometiam. Australia: Company records from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) and the Australian Business Register (ABR): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated weekly. Proprietary, public and foreign companies (ACN and ARBN) only; associations, cooperatives, other bodies, individuals and sole traders are never served. The register gives the state and the postcode, not a street address. ASIC does not separate liquidation from administration, so external administration shows as in_administration and there is no in_liquidation status; there are no insolvency notices. No activity code or share capital. The VAT number is the ABN when the ABN is active and registered for GST; an ABN is searchable with abn= and a GST-registered one with vat=. Data are licensed CC BY 3.0 AU (no sublicensing): the credit and licence link travel with every answer. Credit: Contains data from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) Company Dataset and the Australian Business Register (ABN Bulk Extract), licensed CC BY 3.0 AU (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). Adapted by Prometiam (joined, normalised, status derived). Japan: Company records from the National Tax Agency corporate number publication site: legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day, with a monthly full reconciliation. Companies (kabushiki, godo, gomei, goshi and tokurei yugen kaisha) and registered foreign companies only; national and local government bodies, associations and other corporations are never served. Status is active, deregistered or merged (with the successor's number): the register publishes no liquidation or insolvency state and there are no insolvency notices; the employee count, share capital, date of establishment (served as the founding date), website and industry division only for the companies whose figures gBizINFO (METI) holds, each with its source in registry_details and never a value a company typed itself (the industry is a JSIC division: no NACE or ISIC class). The VAT number is the T-number (T and the 13-digit corporate number) from the register of qualified invoice issuers kept by the National Tax Agency, served while the registration is in force; it is null for a company that is not registered, whose registration was cancelled or has expired, or that pays consumption tax without being a qualified invoice issuer (null does not mean the company is not a taxpayer). The registration date is the date the corporate number was assigned and is null for companies that carry only the 5 October 2015 designation. Names are in Japanese; the English name, the kana reading and a romanised name are in registry_details. tools.description: Search normalized corporate-event records (capital changes, director changes, dissolutions, mergers, insolvency, name changes, etc.) by company, or, with neither company_name nor company_number, as the country event feed (every event of that country, country then required, newest first, from date_from: default 7 days ago, at most 31 days back), for Spain, France and the UK (from their gazettes) and, as register-change events, for Ireland, Poland, Norway, Finland, Sweden, Belgium, Croatia, Denmark, Estonia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Latvia, Cyprus, Romania, Lithuania, Canada, Australia, Japan, Israel, Singapore, Colombia, Taiwan, Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, Ukraine, Serbia, Slovenia, South Korea, Malta, Ecuador, Argentina, Greece, Moldova, Brazil, Mexico (LEI-registered entities only: a company only INEGI's DENUE directory lists has none), the United States and every LEI layer (more than 20 jurisdictions, including Austria, Italy, India, Luxembourg and China). Returns events with a served event_type matching this enum for each of those countries (each row also carries act_type, the raw BORME/BODACC/Companies House code it was derived from, or null when not yet covered), event date, before/after values, and source notice URL. The register-change events of the five (name, status, legal form and registered address; share capital for HR, EE, SK, CH, LV, LT, TW, BR and CZ; for Ukraine name, status, legal form and share capital, no registered address; for Serbia the address is the municipality; for Ecuador the address is the canton) are dated when the change first appears in the register data (for the United States, the weekly read of the registers that first sees it), are not gazette notices and start on 2026-09-30 (Ecuador and Mexico: none before their launch). Ireland, Poland and Norway publish no gazette either; their register-change events are dated the same way and none are before 14 Oct 2026. Every event carries advertising_protected: for a Danish company the CVR advertising-protection mark (CVR act s.19; true means do not use the event for direct marketing, and pass the company name or address on only with the mark), null otherwise.

tools.name: person_detail
tools.description: Fetch a single person (officer / director) by Prometiam internal ID. Returns the person's full appointment history across all companies; `is_beneficial_owner` on an appointment is true only for a person-with-significant-control entry of the United Kingdom register (false for every other appointment and country; not a determination of beneficial ownership). Useful for director-network analysis and counterparty due diligence. Get the ID from a company_detail or people_search response. UK disqualified directors: on a GB person, `disqualifications` is the person's entry on the Companies House register of disqualified directors (orders and undertakings under the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986, and sanctions-regime disqualifications) with each period, the section of the Act, whether it is an order, an undertaking or a sanction, and the companies named; null when the person is not on the register. Matched on the words of the full name and the month and year of birth together (the register publishes no id shared with the officer records), so only persons with significant control, whose birth month is held, can match, never a director listed without a birth month; two register entries with the same name and birth month match nobody; `match_basis` says whether a company named in the disqualification is also one the person is linked to. Data changed: selected, joined and normalised by Prometiam. Mexico (MX): two sources, one record per company. (1) LEI holders (GLEIF golden copy, CC0 1.0): the company number is the LEI (also lei=), with register-change events and monitoring. (2) The companies of the DENUE directory of INEGI (Mexico's national statistics institute). DENUE is a statistical directory of economic units, not the Mexican company register and not a list of all Mexican companies. A unit is served as a company only when it carries a razón social and shows evidence of being a company's (a legal form in the name, a word that says business, a second unit under one INEGI enterprise code, or a match with an LEI holder); natural persons, public bodies, public-sector schools, associations, funds, trusts, branches and sole establishments are screened out, not guaranteed out. For a company only DENUE lists: the name as INEGI publishes it (the legal form is stripped from most names, so legal_form is set only where the name carries one); status null (local_status unknown); no founding date, age or dissolution date; the head-office address with postal code, municipality and locality (registry_details.address_basis); the activity as the head-office unit's SCIAN 2018 code with INEGI's title (activity_code_scheme MX-SCIAN-2018; no NACE, ISIC or NAICS code is derived); employee_band, the size band of the largest unit (a floor for the company, never a head count); registry_details.establishments, the units listed under the name (can undercount); registry_details.denue_listed_since (not a founding date); the website only where DENUE gives a plausible host name; source_provider INEGI. No officers, share capital, VAT number (a vat search is refused), financial statements, insolvency notices or register-change events, and monitoring raises sanctions matches only. The company number of such a company is E plus INEGI's four-digit enterprise code, a dash and eight hexadecimal digits (E0042-0A1B2C3D), or U plus INEGI's unit id (U1001): an identifier of this API, not an INEGI or tax number, and not promised stable until a second INEGI edition has been compared; company_number takes it as well as an LEI. An LEI holder that is also in DENUE keeps GLEIF's data (registry_details.source stays gleif) and gains the DENUE fields. INEGI publishes the directory about twice a year (registry_details.denue_edition). Credit: Fuente: INEGI, Directorio Estadístico Nacional de Unidades Económicas (DENUE) 05/2026. Adapted by Prometiam; not an INEGI product and not endorsed by INEGI. tools.name: sanctions_screen

Returns matches with a match score (0–100, by match type as on company search: 100 the name is the query, 80–99 it starts with it, 50–79 it holds the words, under 50 only parts of words), source list, aliases and the country as an ISO code (country_as_listed keeps the spelling as listed); the same entity on several lists is one row per list unless group is entity. Names in non-Latin scripts (Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic and others) are transliterated to Latin letters, in the query and in the listed names, before matching, so a name in its own script and in Latin spelling match the same entity. Use threshold to control match strictness. BETA. Optional include_offshore_leaks=true adds a separate offshore_leaks object from the ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database: a mention, never a sanction (not in the hits, the match flag, the risk level, monitoring or the watchlist), static data to 2021, entities and organisation intermediaries only, name match only; ICIJ's disclaimer comes verbatim in offshore_leaks.notice and must travel with any use of the matches; no extra credit.

tools.name: insolvency_notices_search
tools.description: Search CORPORATE insolvency notices published in official gazettes and registers across France, Germany, the UK, Austria, Switzerland, Norway, Finland, the US, the Netherlands, Denmark, Croatia, Sweden, Spain, Latvia, Estonia and Singapore. Use this for distress coverage in all sixteen markets. DE, AT, US and NL notices stand alone: they are not linked to company records (German and US company records come from other sources and do not carry them). FR, GB, NO and ES notices are linked by company number or NIF, and the notices of the other registry countries can be cross-referenced against companies_search with the same country code (for FI, DK, HR, SE and CH the notices are linked by business ID, CVR number, MBS, organisationsnummer and UID: a company record with include=insolvency returns them; a Swiss notice is linked only where the SHAB notice names the debtor's UID, and one without a UID stays unlinked). DK notices come from CVR credit information (konkurs and tvangsakkord: one notice per proceeding, dated by the decision that opened it, with the latest stage of the proceeding; no court or case number); HR notices are court decisions from the Croatian court register (only companies still on the register); SE notices are Bolagsverket's procedure data (konkurs, företagsrekonstruktion, ackordsförhandling), updated weekly, with no court, case number or link, and proceedings that ended before collection are not included. Belgium and Slovakia are not insolvency markets (their bankruptcy shows in the company status). Spanish notices are the concurso entries (declaration, opening of the liquidation phase, conclusion) published in BORME since 2009, one per court resolution, linked by NIF and dated by the court's resolution date with the BORME publication date alongside (a median of about ten weeks later, sometimes more than a year); legal entities with a NIF only, judge and administrator never served, and an entry that cannot be tied to the company, or whose NIF is an administrator's, is withheld. Latvian notices are the Insolvency Register's insolvency and legal protection proceedings, an opening notice and a closing notice each, since 2008, with court and case number where stated, linked by registration number, legal persons of the commercial register only, updated daily. Estonian notices are bankruptcy declarations from the e-Business Register, one per register entry, dated by the entry (a few days after the court's order), linked by registry code, with no court, case number, trustee or closing notice, for companies still on the register, in liquidation or in bankruptcy only (a floor), sole traders (FIE) never served. Singapore notices are the corporate notices of the Singapore Government Gazette (egazette.gov.sg), back to September 1998: winding-up applications and orders, judicial management, and the steps of a creditors' voluntary or court-ordered liquidation (resolutions, meetings of creditors, claims and dividend notices), dated by the order, filing or resolution date where the notice prints it, else by its first publication, with the court and case number where it prints them; members' voluntary (solvent) liquidations are not included and no liquidator, judicial manager or other natural person is served; linked to the company record by the UEN (a company record with include=insolvency returns them), and a notice that prints no valid UEN stays unlinked. Spanish notices: based on data from the Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado (BORME). Contains data from the Insolvency Register of the Republic of Latvia (Register of Enterprises), CC0. Contains data from the Estonian e-Business Register (RIK), CC BY 4.0. Source: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, www.egazette.gov.sg. The e-Gazettes are subject to copyright of the Singapore Government and are reproduced here with the permission of the Singapore Government. You may check www.egazette.gov.sg for the latest e-Gazettes. US notices are not linked to the US company records. Personal/consumer insolvency is deliberately excluded and is never returned. Each row carries source_type (official_publication, court_docket or register_record), court and case_number where the source states them, published_date (ES, SG), date_basis (AT, EE, ES, SG) and vat_number built from the company number for ES, FR, SE, DK and CH (vat_number_source rule; the format is right, VAT registration is not confirmed). insolvency_search returns the same notices, one id per notice, for one company. Contains CVR data (Erhvervsstyrelsen), CC BY 4.0.

The registration may not be current although it reads active: last_renewal_year in registry_details is the last year it was renewed. company_name is the name without those markers and name_as_registered is the name as published. The records, the filing-profile values, the contracts and the fines are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike). The annual return and accounts-due dates are in registry_details as published. API use of the data is licensed, not a right to the data itself. The responsible person is not served. Status includes dissolution, reorganisation, receivership and bankruptcy. The VAT number is the unified business number where the company is in the Ministry of Finance tax file (searchable with vat=), else null. Updated daily. Commercial legal persons only (s.r.o., a.s., v.o.s., k.s., cooperatives, SE, SCE and EEIG); sole traders (OSVČ) and every other natural person, associations, foundations, trust funds, owners associations (SVJ) and branches are never served. Status includes liquidation, insolvency, bankruptcy and restructuring; there are no insolvency notices (the Czech Republic is not one of the sixteen insolvency markets) and no financial statements. No VAT number: a vat search is refused. The activity code is CZ-NACE 2025. The IČO has eight digits and its check digit is advisory, so companies whose IČO fails it are served. The registering court and file number (for example B 1581, Městský soud v Praze) are in registry_details. Credit: Contains data from the public registers of the Czech Republic (Ministry of Justice, ISVR open data) and the Czech Statistical Office (RES, CC BY 4.0). Adapted by Prometiam. Netherlands (NL): LEI-registered entities with a KVK number (GLEIF golden copy, CC0 1.0), not the Dutch commercial register (Handelsregister, KVK); company number = the 8-digit KVK number, lei a second identifier; BV, NV, SE, cooperatives, SCE, OWM, CV and VOF only, no sole proprietorships, foundations, associations, public bodies, funds or branches; no officers, share capital, activity code or VAT number; financial statements (company_financials) only for the banks of the EBA Transparency Exercise 2025 (headline figures at 31 December 2024); register-change events (none before 30 Oct 2026) and monitoring. The second source is a partial layer declared by the market actors and not checked against the commercial register: status null (local_status unknown), no founding date, no register-change events; registry_details.source is gleif or mastr. KG), eG and PartG only; sole traders (e.K.) and other natural persons, GbR, associations (e.V.), foundations, public-law bodies, funds and branches are never served. (1) LEI holders (GLEIF golden copy, CC0 1.0): the company number is the LEI (also lei=), with register-change events and monitoring. (2) The companies of the DENUE directory of INEGI (Mexico's national statistics institute). DENUE is a statistical directory of economic units, not the Mexican company register and not a list of all Mexican companies. A unit is served as a company only when it carries a razón social and shows evidence of being a company's (a legal form in the name, a word that says business, a second unit under one INEGI enterprise code, or a match with an LEI holder); natural persons, public bodies, public-sector schools, associations, funds, trusts, branches and sole establishments are screened out, not guaranteed out. company_number.description: Registry number: NIF (ES), SIREN (FR), Companies House number (GB), CRO (IE), KRS (PL), organisasjonsnummer (NO).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Safe-replay key for this exact batch (1-255 printable ASCII); a repeat within 24h is free and returns the stored result.

tools.name: sanctions_screen_batch
tools.description: Screen up to 50 names against the sanctions lists in ONE call (POST /sanctions/screen). Requires the sanctions scope (batch calls do not use the free trial allowance); every item costs 3 credits, an item that errs or times out nothing. Per-item status: match / clear / error / timeout. "clear" means no hit at or above the threshold on the active lists, not a certification. Optional idempotency_key: replaying the same key with the same items within 24h returns the original response for free (409 if still running, 422 if the items differ).

group.description: entity: one row per listed person/company with lists[] and sources[] instead of one row per source list.

list.description: Comma-separated source lists to restrict to, e.g. OFAC,EU,UN.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Safe-replay key for this exact batch (1-255 printable ASCII); a repeat within 24h is free and returns the stored result.

tools.name: insolvency_check
tools.description: Check up to 100 counterparties for CORPORATE insolvency notices in ONE call (POST /insolvency/check) across FR, DE, GB, AT, CH, NO, FI, US, NL, DK, HR, SE, ES, LV, EE and SG. Each item: country plus company_number (alias siren; exact, as printed on the notice) or name. Returns up to 5 notices per item, newest first, plus latest_filing_date; status found / none / error / timeout. "none" is not proof of solvency. Every item costs 2 credits, an item that errs or times out nothing. Optional idempotency_key: replaying the same key with the same items within 24h returns the original response for free (409 if still running, 422 if the items differ).

company_number.description: Registry number as printed on the notice (SIREN for FR, HRB for DE with the register court, e.g. HRB 12653 Frankfurt am Main, since an HRB number repeats across courts, Companies House number for GB, org number for NO...).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Safe-replay key for this exact batch (1-255 printable ASCII); a repeat within 24h is free and returns the stored result.

tools.name: insolvency_record
tools.description: Fetch one corporate insolvency notice by its id (GET /records/{id}, 1 credit), from insolvency_search or insolvency_notices_search, in any of the sixteen insolvency markets your key may read: the fields of insolvency_search plus notice_text (Spain: the BORME label; Germany: the notice line; null elsewhere) and raw_data (Spain only: the court, procedure number, kind, the resolution and publication dates and the BORME id; never the debtor's identifiers; null elsewhere). Ids from the earlier Spanish-only version of this endpoint no longer apply.

id.description: Notice id, from insolvency_search or insolvency_notices_search.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Returns dataset coverage statistics: per-country company count, event count, person count, latest filing date, and data sources. Use this when a user asks "what countries does Prometiam cover?" or "how fresh is the data?".

tools.name: account
tools.description: Returns the calling API key's account info and current usage: plan tier, rate limits (per minute in requests, per day / month in credits), credits used and left, and enabled scopes. It also returns the purposes declared for the account and for this key (declared_purposes, key_purposes; null until declared) and the legal documents the account accepted (accepted_documents: document, version, day, link). Costs no credits. Use this to check "how many credits do I have left?".

tools.name: vat_validate
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT number against VIES (the European Commission's VAT Information Exchange System) and return the registered trader name and address when valid. Covers the 27 EU member states plus XI (Northern Ireland); Greek numbers use the EL prefix and GB VAT is out of scope post-Brexit. Live official check — returns a retryable error when a member-state registry is temporarily down (not a false "invalid"). When VIES says a Spanish or German number is valid but withholds the name, registry_match {company_id, company_name, address, register} names the company our register holds under that number: register data, not VIES confirmation.

vat.description: Full VAT number including the 2-letter country prefix, e.g. IE6388047V or DE811569869. Spaces and punctuation are ignored.

tools.name: einvoicing_check
tools.description: Check an e-invoicing reference, or give the e-invoicing identifiers of a company. Two modes. (1) type and reference: an OFFLINE check of one reference, such as a party identifier (a VAT or tax number), a routing code (de_leitweg_id, it_sdi_code) or an invoice identifier (pl_ksef_number, br_nfe_key). The answer says whether it is well formed: basis check_digit means it has the form its publisher defines and its check characters match; basis format means only the form was checked; parts decodes a structured value as written in it. Neither basis means the reference was issued, is registered or active, or that a tax authority accepts an invoice that carries it; no live status from a national tax authority is served. type peppol_id also looks the participant up live in the Peppol network (registered at the time of the check; registered does not mean it receives invoices: receives_invoices, receives_credit_notes and document_types come from its SMP, and where the SMP is not read, for example when its robots.txt disallows it, they are null and document_types_unread says why). (2) country and company_number, or vat: for a company the API serves, its own e-invoicing identifiers (party_ids), its Peppol participant IDs looked up live (only those its company number and VAT number give: a company not found under them may be registered under another ID or receive e-invoices outside Peppol; the Peppol Directory is not read), and for Estonia the e-invoice recipients register (Contains data from the Estonian e-Business Register (RIK), CC BY 4.0). Prometiam is not a Peppol access point: it does not send, receive or validate invoices. 1 credit a call, errors free. The full list of types, by country, is on https://www.prometiam.com/risk-api/docs#einvoicing-check.

type.description: Reference mode: the reference type, for example de_leitweg_id, pl_ksef_number, it_sdi_code, fr_siren, br_nfe_key or peppol_id. The types are listed on the docs page; an unknown type is refused and the types of its country are named.

reference.description: Reference mode: the value to check. Required with type.

country.description: Company mode: the country of company_number.

company_number.description: Company mode: the company number in its register, with country.

vat.description: Company mode: the VAT number of the company, with its country prefix.

tools.name: lei_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) in the GLEIF global register by its 20-character ISO 17442 code. Returns legal name, jurisdiction, entity and registration status, legal/HQ address, managing LOU, and next renewal date, and the ISINs GLEIF links to the LEI (identifiers.isin, at most 100, with isin_count; CC0). Use to validate or enrich a counterparty that publishes an LEI.

tools.name: lei_search
tools.description: Search the GLEIF global LEI register by legal-entity name (full-text). Returns candidate LEIs with legal name, jurisdiction, status, and city/country — use to resolve a company name to its LEI before lei_lookup. Ranked by match_score (exact name, then names starting with yours, then names holding the words), so name=telefonica lists TELEFONICA SA first.

name.description: Legal entity name to search for.

tools.name: lei_relationships
tools.description: GLEIF Level 2 corporate ownership ("who owns whom") for a 20-character LEI: its direct parent, ultimate parent, and direct children — each with LEI, legal name, jurisdiction, status, and city/country. Reveals the accountable ownership chain behind an entity. Only relationships reported to GLEIF are returned (many entities report none).

tools.name: monitor_list
tools.description: List the companies currently subscribed to ongoing monitoring for this API key, with their labels and last-alert timestamps. Company monitoring (ES, FR, GB, IE, PL, NO, FI, SE, BE, HR, DK, EE, SK, CH, LV, CY, RO, LT, CA, AU, JP, IL, SG, CO, TW, BR, CZ, DE, IT, IN, AT, CN, VG, LU, KY, HU, PT, JE, LI, AE, GG, TR, PA, SA, IS, BS, MU, IM, BM, ZA, GR, LU, HU, PT, JE, MX, NL, AR, UA, RS, SI, MT, EC, IT, IN, AT, GR, LU, HU, PT, US) emits status changes, dissolutions, sanctions matches and, for ES, FR, GB, IE/PL/NO (the last three from 14 Oct 2026) and FI/SE/BE/HR/DK/EE/SK/CH/LV/CY/RO/LT/CA/AU/JP/IL/SG/CO/TW/BR/CZ/DE/IT/IN/AT/CN/VG/LU/KY/HU/PT/JE/LI/AE/GG/TR/PA/SA/IS/BS/MU/IM/BM/ZA/GR/LU/HU/PT/JE/MX/NL/AR/UA/RS/SI/MT/EC/IT/IN/AT/GR/LU/HU/PT/US, corporate events to a webhook. On request (events: lei_lapsed) it also alerts when the LEI of a company goes from renewed to LAPSED: an unpaid renewal, not a sign of distress. On request too (events: financial_flag, Scale plan and above, for GB, RO, SE, NO, DK, EE, LV, LT and FI; not FR) it alerts when a warning flag of the latest annual accounts turns on: an indicator, never a rating.

tools.name: monitor_get
tools.description: Get one monitored company by its monitor ID, including its alert history (events/status/sanctions matches, new public-contract awards and public grants detected since subscription).

id.description: Monitor subscription ID (from monitor_subscribe or monitor_list).

tools.name: monitor_subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe a company to ongoing monitoring. Status changes, dissolutions, sanctions matches and corporate events (ES, FR (BODACC notices), GB, IE/PL/NO (the last three from 14 Oct 2026) and FI/SE/BE/HR/DK/EE/SK/CH/LV/CY/RO/LT/CA/AU/JP/IL/SG/CO/TW/BR/CZ/DE/IT/IN/AT/CN/VG/LU/KY/HU/PT/JE/LI/AE/GG/TR/PA/SA/IS/BS/MU/IM/BM/ZA/GR/LU/HU/PT/JE/MX/NL/AR/UA/RS/SI/MT/EC/IT/IN/AT/GR/LU/HU/PT/US) are checked every 30 minutes from 05:00 to 22:30 UTC and POSTed to your webhook_url (HMAC-SHA256 signed). Returns the monitor ID and a webhook_secret (shown once). Available for Spain (ES), France (FR), the United Kingdom (GB), Ireland (IE), Poland (PL), Norway (NO), Finland (FI), Sweden (SE), Belgium (BE), Croatia (HR), Denmark (DK), Estonia (e-Business Register), Slovakia (RPO), Switzerland (Zefix), Latvia (Register of Enterprises), Cyprus (DRCOR), Romania (ONRC), Lithuania (JAR), Canada (federal corporations), Australia (ASIC and ABR), Japan (NTA), Israel (Corporations Authority), Singapore (ACRA), Colombia (RUES), Taiwan (GCIS), Brazil (CNPJ), Argentina (RNS, read monthly: no events before 28 Oct 2026, and no dissolution alert), the Czech Republic, Germany (LEI-registered entities and energy-market register companies, sanctions matches only for the latter), the Netherlands (LEI-registered entities with a KVK number), Mexico (LEI-registered entities; a company only INEGI's DENUE directory lists raises sanctions matches only), Ukraine, Serbia, Slovenia, Malta, Ecuador, Greece, Moldova and every LEI layer (more than 20 jurisdictions, including Austria, Italy, India, Luxembourg and China), that is every live country except Chile, South Korea, New Caledonia, Peru, Honduras, Guatemala, Uruguay, the Dominican Republic, New Zealand, Bulgaria, Georgia, Tanzania and Zambia. A dissolution alert fires on the dissolution date the register gives or, where the register gives none (Canada, Israel, Singapore, Taiwan, Romania, many US registrations), when the status first shows closed (detail.date_basis first_seen_closed, else register). Two more alert types, contract_awarded and grant_received, are opt-in and sent only when listed in events: contract_awarded is a public-contract award newly published with the company as supplier (the monitored countries of procurement_awards: not Chile), dated by the award date the buyer published, else the day it was first seen (detail.date_basis award_date or first_seen), with buyer, amount awarded (not a payment), currency and source; France: a closure alert only when a company not seen closed becomes closed (dated by the register, which can be months old); a company that withheld its name is monitored by SIREN, unnamed and not screened against sanctions lists; no financial-flag alert. Spanish contracts published only on a regional platform (Catalonia, the Basque Country, Navarre, Madrid, Andalusia, Galicia, La Rioja) are not covered. grant_received is a public grant newly published for the company (Spain only, legal entities, concessions from 26 Sep 2026), dated by the concession date; a grant registered late is alerted late, and a grant is never a risk. Sanctions matches: the company's register name is screened against the sanctions lists when monitoring starts, again when its register name changes, and against each listing a list adds or changes. An alert fires only at a match_score of 80 or more on the sanctions screen scale (100: a listed name or alias is the company's name; 80-99: a listed name starts with the company's name, or ends with it after a few leading words such as "Banco"); one alert per monitor, after which the company is not screened again. detail carries match_score, matched_name, matched_on (name or alias), entity_name, entity_id, source_list and trigger (company_screen or list_change). Sanctions screening is beta: a match is a prompt to look, not a finding. This creates a persistent subscription, active until it is stopped with monitor_stop.

Monitoring is not available for CL, KR, NC, PE, HN, GT, UY, DO, NZ, BG, GE, TZ or ZM.

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for this subscription.

events.description: Optional list of event types to filter alerts to (default: all applicable: corporate_event, status_change, dissolution, sanctions_match). Also available on request, never by default: lei_lapsed, an alert when the LEI of the company goes from a renewed status to LAPSED while you watch it (detail: lei, from, to, next_renewal, days_since_renewal_due). A lapse is an unpaid or unconfirmed LEI renewal, not a sign of distress. Only for a company with an LEI link; a company whose LEI is already lapsed when you subscribe does not alert for it. Also on request, never by default: financial_flag (Scale plan and above; GB, RO, SE, NO, DK, EE, LV, LT and FI), an alert when a warning flag of the latest annual accounts turns on (detail: flags, active_flags, fiscal_year, period_end, statement_type, filing_date); a flag already on when you subscribe does not alert. An indicator read from accounts that can be up to three years old, never a rating. Also on request, never by default: contract_awarded and grant_received (a public-contract award or a public grant newly published for the company; the limits are in the description of this tool); they are never sent unless listed here. Re-sending a company with events changes what it receives.

tools.name: monitor_stop
tools.description: Stop monitoring a company and delete its subscription by monitor ID. This is irreversible — the alert history is removed.

tools.name: sanctions_changes
tools.description: List additions, removals and amendments detected on the sanctions lists, newest first. Use this to answer "what changed recently" without re-screening a whole book of business — each change carries the entity it affects, so a hit can be joined back to sanctions_entity.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only changes detected after it.

change_type.description: Restrict to one kind of change.

tools.name: sanctions_watchlist
tools.description: Return your sanctions watchlists and any recent hits against them. Requires the sanctions_watch scope; the number of entries allowed depends on your tier. Add entries with sanctions_watch and remove them with sanctions_unwatch.
